reviewer: Kimi actually viewed the exact 156x210 original, the complete unchanged external-02 1776x2368 RGB raw and the complete white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet. Checked cap, brows, fur collar, collar tabs, neck cross, expression, crop, full backplate and task/prompt/request/result bindings. RGB art is approved before any alpha operation; this is not final production or game approval.

hair_features.reason: Covered hairline and sideburns, dark eyebrows and a clean smooth chin are retained without adding a moustache, beard or glasses. Cap eagle, cross badge, braid and visor remain coherent.

collar_fit.reason: The mottled fur collar sits naturally around the compact round head and short broad neck, with black oakleaf/pip tabs and neck cross retained. No long narrow neck column, floating collar, pinching or cream bib is visible.

entry.positive_observation: The cap has its eagle, separate cross badge, braided cords and glossy visor. Dark brows and a restrained mouth remain. The heavy mottled fur collar, black collar tabs with silver oakleaf motifs and pips, neck cross, direct gaze, crop and pale grey-beige full backplate are preserved without adding a frame, note, person or new backdrop.
entry.alpha_decision: The original has alpha 255 in all 32760 pixels with no transparent exterior. The returned RGB has returned_alpha_extrema null. Full white/cyan comparisons show an intact opaque backplate and clothing with no visible holes, haze or missing background. Only a separate source-alpha BILINEAR restoration is eligible; RGB itself is not production approval.
entry.visible_limitations: Individual fur tufts and exact collar-tab heraldry and pip details remain limited by the 156x210 source. Approval covers visible hair, clothing, collar, composition and opaque backing, not invented microscopic lettering or symbols.
